title: Records examined after a fictional batch failure
method: Synthetic 1,000-record job with ten 100-record chunks. Failure follows six atomically committed chunks. Full replay examines 1,000; valid checkpoint resumes 1,000 − 600 = 400. Assumes stable input and no partial seventh chunk; not a runtime benchmark.
alt: Records examined after a fictional batch failure. Restart from beginning: 1000 records after restart; Resume six committed chunks: 400 records after restart. Illustrative inputs.
